aspect: Non-naturalisation is the regional norm, not an oversight
description: Host states have largely not permitted naturalisation, granting neither citizenship nor residency documents despite long residence: Lebanon, Syria, Egypt and the Gulf states. Jordan is the single exception, and that followed from its 1948 annexation.
energy_note: Seventy years resident, still a foreigner.
notes: Sourced via Russian-language coverage (Current Time / evolutio.info), which states the non-naturalisation rule more directly than the English sources found.

aspect: The status is inherited, so the population grows
description: Refugee status passes to descendants. Roughly 750,000 registered in 1950; over 5 million by 2013; over 5.6 million registered with UNRWA by 2019, over 1.5 million of them in the 59 recognised camps.
energy_note: A legal condition with a birth rate.

aspect: Even in Jordan, citizenship is not uniform
description: Jordan is the only Arab state to have granted citizenship, but not all Palestinians in Jordan hold it and not all who hold it have full rights. The presence or absence of a national number is the dividing line.
energy_note: A citizenship with a missing field.

aspect: Statelessness blocks the ordinary machinery of adult life
description: Property, a business licence, a professional registration, a mortgage, a pension, a marriage registration, a driving licence in some jurisdictions. Each requires a nationality field that cannot be filled.
energy_note: A form with a box you can never complete.

aspect: And it cannot be escaped by achievement
description: A doctorate, a business, forty years of tax and three children born in the country do not convert into status where the law does not provide for conversion. Effort is not a route out of this one.
energy_note: Nothing you accomplish changes the category.

aspect: EXAMPLE - expelled from the Gulf, received by Jordan
description: After the 1991 Gulf War, Jordan received Palestinians expelled from Gulf states. A population holding no citizenship anywhere can be removed from anywhere, and periodically is - the expulsion requiring no legal process because there is no status to revoke.
energy_note: Removable from every country you have ever lived in.
